name: animated-headline
title: Animated Headline
description: A headline that reveals word-by-word with a 3D flip-up, rotates its last word on a timer, and draws a gradient shimmer underline that resizes to each word and replays on every swap. A recreation of the x.ai hero effect.
docs: Render <AnimatedHeadline prefix="Engineering things people love to" words={["build", "design", "ship", "use"]} />. The prefix words flip up in sequence on mount; the last word cycles through `words` on a ~2s beat with a gradient shimmer underline that resizes to each word. Honours prefers-reduced-motion by rendering the settled state. Requires the hero-underline-shimmer keyframe (installed automatically via the css field).
